title: A gland signals another
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: Thyroid-stimulating hormone, or TSH, stimulates the thyroid gland. Thyroid hormones participate in feedback regulation of the axis.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which anterior-pituitary hormone stimulates thyroid hormone production and release? Thyroid-stimulating hormone, or TSH, stimulates the thyroid gland. Thyroid hormones participate in feedback regulation of the axis.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.

Recall: In the stated example, which source releases TSH into the circulation? Thyroid-stimulating hormone, or TSH, stimulates the thyroid gland. Thyroid hormones participate in feedback regulation of the axis.
